summary: The agent provides a LightGBM regression solution with appropriate temporal feature engineering and a 5-fold cross-validation setup. However, it severely fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a shuffled KFold split, introducing significant look-ahead bias. Additionally, it skips preliminary data cleaning and contains a logical bug where test set predictions are generated using only the model trained on the final CV fold.
